hello: Hello. In one short sentence, who are you?
activities: What small activities can we do together? Please answer briefly.
planning: How can you help me plan something? Give a short answer.
signcapabilities: Briefly describe your communication signs, custom finger poses, pointing, and finite hand sequences.
signshow: Show a thumbs up with your right hand.
signrepeat: Show a thumbs up with your right hand again.
signpropose: Propose, but do not start: after I demonstrate a right hand thumbs up and accept, show peace with your right hand silently on my next right hand thumbs up. One action total. I give the sign and judge the display; you show peace. Success means I find the digital sign correct. Use default settings.
posepropose: Propose one task, but wait for preparation and acceptance. When my left index is stretched with its other four fingers bent, and my right thumb is stretched with its other four fingers bent in the same frame, reproduce that two hand pattern silently once. I demonstrate the pattern and judge the digital result; you reproduce it. One action total. Use default settings.
poseshow: Silently stretch your left index and bend the other four left fingers. At the same time stretch your right thumb and bend the other four right fingers.
ringshow: I mean the divers OK ring: close the thumb and index into a loop and stretch the other three fingers. Show that ring with your right hand silently.
ringpropose: Propose, but wait for preparation and acceptance: when my right thumb and index tips have a normalized gap below zero point one eight, and the right middle, ring and little fingers are stretched, show the divers OK ring with your right hand silently once. I demonstrate and judge the display. You show the ring. One action total; use default timing.
directionpropose: I face the camera, so my left is image right. Propose, but wait for my demonstration and acceptance: when I point to my left with my right index, point to your own right with your right hand silently once. I demonstrate and judge the digital direction. You point. One action total; use default timing.
directionshow: Point to your own left with your left hand silently.
displaypropose: Propose one task: when I point at the registered Display, say Ready once. First check my pointing demonstration, then wait for acceptance and a fresh cue. I point and judge the response; you say Ready. One action total. Use default timing.
displayshow: Point at the registered Display with your right hand silently.
cuppropose: Propose, but do not start: when I point at the selected target labelled My cup, say Ready once. First check my demonstration, then ask for acceptance and wait for a fresh cue. I point and judge the response; you say Ready. One action total, default timing.
personshow: Point at the selected person labelled Visitor with your right hand silently.
personrepeat: Point at that same Visitor again, silently.
inputpropose: Propose, but do not start: I show one, then two, then three stretched fingers on my right hand, with the remaining fingers bent at each step. Recognize this ordered sequence during preparation. After acceptance, say Ready once only when I repeat the whole sequence. I show the counts and judge the response; you acknowledge it. One action total, default timing.
outputcount: Count one through five on your right hand silently, extending thumb, then index, middle, ring and little finger in order. Hold each count for half a second.
outputrepeat: Count one through five on your right hand silently again, in the same order, holding each count for one second.
outputpropose: Propose, but do not start: when my right index is stretched and the other four right fingers are bent, count one through three silently with your right hand, extending thumb then index then middle. Hold each count for half a second. First recognize my demonstration; then ask for acceptance and wait for a fresh cue. I show the pose and judge your display; you count. One action total.
ordinarynew: Show the attention sign with your right index up silently.
